description:
Visual multi-agent AI orchestration that runs on your Claude subscription.

Concentus is a desktop app for building and running teams of AI agents on a canvas. The drawing
is the program: agents, conditions with a real else branch, an on-error output on every block,
sub-flows, verifiers, and knowledge bases with citations — executed through Claude Code on the
subscription already on your machine, or an Anthropic API key. Embedded PostgreSQL, no server,
and your data stays local.
